title: Default-off experimental delivery, no model turn
method: the capability is gated on the install option experimentalTrajectoryContextDelivery, DEFAULT OFF; the Capsule is materialized into the attempt worker context BEFORE any model turn
observed: with the option absent, compiled.trajectoryCapsule is undefined and the worker context is unchanged; with it enabled and an authorized lineage, the bounded Capsule is present; no model request occurs; R2-E efficacy env vars are untouched
expectedInvariant: default production behavior is unchanged when the experimental capability is OFF; delivery is not model-controlled
remainingUncertainty: the delivered Capsule is CAPSULE_RENDERED_FOR_WORKER, not MODEL_CONSUMED_CAPSULE; the host prompt composition is unchanged (the Capsule rides in context.compiled), so a host MAY render it, but this stage does not modify the host prompt
